name: 11713 · Bellport, NY
findings: ZIP 11713 (Bellport) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11713 (Bellport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11713 (Bellport) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
